explanation: The disk inequality becomes r² − 4r cos(θ) ≤ 0, giving 0 ≤ r ≤ 4cos(θ) and −π/2 ≤ θ ≤ π/2. Substituting x = r cos(θ), y = r sin(θ), and dA = r dr dθ gives r⁴cos²(θ)sin(θ), matching option b. Other choices may also evaluate to zero by symmetry, but b directly expresses the given domain and transformed integrand.
